properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated January 30, [1954], at his office; includes description of lawsuit by the U.S. Department of Justice against Pan American World Airways and Panagra, as well as competition with Northwest Airlines for Pacific routes; includes description of offer (marked “Confidential”) of Pacific routes owned by Philippine Air Lines to Pan American by Colonel Soriano, Bixby’s analysis of the deal, and a meeting with J.T.T. [Juan Trippe], Hy Friendly, John Leslie.
